announcement.raw: X-99.1 2 exhibit991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 July 24, 2026 Bank of America Increases Common Stock Dividend 14% to $0.32 Per Share CHARLOTTE, NC – Bank of America Corporation today announced that the Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend on Bank of America common stock of $0.32 per share, up $0.04 from the prior quarter, an increase of 14%. The dividend is payable on September 25, 2026 to shareholders of record as of September 4, 2026.
